events.title: 리버풀 pay a club record fee of £3.6 million for 코번트리 시티 and Republic of Ireland defender Phil Babb .
리버풀 further enhance their defence with a £3.5 million move for 윔블던's John Scales .

Former 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and England captain Billy Wright dies of cancer aged 70. On the same day, his former club draw 1–1 draw with 선덜랜드 at Roker Park in Division One. 미들즈브러 remain top of Division One despite dropping points for the first time this season in a 1–1 draw at 왓퍼드 . The biggest scoreline of the day in that division is 볼턴 원더러스 's 4–0 win over 스토크 시티 at Burnden Park .

Dean Holdsworth – dismayed by the departures of John Fashanu and John Scales over the past two months – submits a transfer request at 윔블던, who strip him of the club captaincy , awarding it to Vinnie Jones .
Romanian World Cup midfielder Gheorghe Popescu signs for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in a club record £2.9 million deal from PSV 에인트호번 .

맨체스터 유나이티드 sell striker Dion Dublin to 코번트리 시티 for £2 million (a record buy for Phil Neal 's team). Dublin's value doubled in two years at Old Trafford after signing from 케임브리지 유나이티드 , but a broken leg in his first season – coupled with the arrival of Eric Cantona – saw his first team opportunities limited. On the same day, his new club are held to a 2–2 draw by QPR at Loftus Road . 에버턴 crash to the bottom of the Premier League with a 3–0 defeat at 블랙번 로버스, having picked up one point from their first five league games. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 take their 100% start to the season to five games with a 4–2 home win over 첼시, with second-placed 노팅엄 포리스트 beating 셰필드 웬즈데이 4–1 at the City Ground. In Division One, newly promoted Reading move into second place with a 3–1 win over Oldham at Boundary Park . 울버햄프턴 원더러스 move into third place with a 2–0 home win over Tranmere.

리즈 유나이티드 beat rival club 맨체스터 유나이티드 for the first time in more than a decade, defeating them 2–1 in the league at Elland Road . A north-eastern derby match in Division One sees 미들즈브러 and 선덜랜드 draw 2–2 at Ayresome Park in what is likely to the last time 미들즈브러 play either of their north-eastern rivals there; work is beginning on a new 30,000-seater stadium on the banks of the River Tees which is planned to open in time for next season.

울버햄프턴 원더러스 go top of Division One with a 5–0 home win over 사우스엔드 유나이티드. Bolton surge 10 places into fifth place with a 3–0 win at Luton . 그림즈비 타운 make a similar surge into seventh place by beating 포트 베일 4–1 at home. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 로열 앤트워프 5–0 in Belgium in their first European fixture for 17 years, with midfielder Robert Lee scoring a hat-trick.

맨체스터 유나이티드 begin their quest for the European Cup with a 4–2 home win over Swedish champions IFK Gothenburg in the first game of the group stage. 라이언 긱스 scores twice. 미들즈브러 return to the top of Division One with a 2–1 home win over bottom club 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 .

Dion Dublin scores on his 코번트리 시티 debut, a 2–1 home league win over 리즈 유나이티드. 레스터 시티 achieve their first Premier League win – 3–1 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼, with young striker Julian Joachim scoring twice. 노팅엄 포리스트 are held to a 1–1 draw at 사우샘프턴 and miss the chance to go top of the league. Bryan Robson experiences his first league defeat as a manager when 미들즈브러 lose 2–1 at 포트 베일 in Division One, surrendering top place to 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who win 1–0 at 번리 .
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 make it six straight wins from the start of the Premier League campaign with a 3–2 win at 아스널, while 블랙번 로버스 move into second place by beating 첼시 2–1 at Stamford Bridge .
The East Anglian derby at Portman Road sees 노리치 시티 beat 입스위치 타운 2–1.

게리 리네커 , England's second highest goalscorer of all time, announces his retirement from playing. Since leaving 토트넘 홋스퍼 in 1992, he has played for 나고야 그램퍼스 Eight of Japan. In the League Cup , a weakened 맨체스터 유나이티드 side beat 포트 베일 2–1 at Vale Park in the second round first leg, with 19-year-old striker 폴 스콜스 scoring twice on his first team debut.

UEFA announces that the Summer Cup will be re-introduced next year and will now be known as the Intertoto Cup . It will feature 40 clubs and at least one Premier League team (the highest placed applicant or applicants who failed to qualify for one of the three major European competitions) will be able to compete.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 drop points for the first time this season with a 1–1 draw at home to 리버풀 but are still top of the Premier League. 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a shock 3–2 defeat at 입스위치 타운, with Paul Mason scoring twice from midfield for the Suffolk side, while 폴 스콜스 scores on his first league appearance for the losers. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 continue to lead Division One on goal difference ahead of 미들즈브러.

위건 애슬레틱 sack manager Kenny Swain after an appalling start to the season, which has seen them lose 8 of their first 9 games and already left the side four points adrift at the bottom of Division Three with most of the teams above them having a game in hand. Former player Graham 배로, who resigned as 체스터 시티 manager two months ago, is announced as Swain's successor.

블랙번 로버스, in Europe for the first time, are eliminated from the UEFA Cup 3–2 on aggregate by Swedish side Trelleborg , but 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 go through 10–2 on aggregate by beating 로열 앤트워프 5–2 on Tyneside, with Andy Cole scoring a hat-trick.

September draws to a close with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still top after winning six of their first seven games, while 블랙번 로버스 and 노팅엄 포리스트 have leapfrogged 맨체스터 유나이티드 into fourth place. Completing the top five are a 첼시 side who are showing some of their best form in years under the management of Glenn Hoddle . 맨체스터 시티 are also giving the top five a run for their money after last season's close shave with relegation. 에버턴 are bottom of the division with no wins from their first seven games, while 크리스털 팰리스, 코번트리 시티 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are all still in the bottom four as well. Graham Taylor is rebuilding his managerial career well at 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who have leapfrogged 미들즈브러 on goals scored at the top of Division One. 스윈던 타운 , 트랜미어 로버스 and Reading complete the top five.
